data.body: Patchset 2 cleared the prior py3.13 complexity-baseline failure. Its py3.11 matrix then lost xdist worker gw3 while running unrelated tests/unit/test_opcert_service_app.py::test_matching_guard_is_accepted at 99%; 11,362 tests had passed, no assertion/traceback was emitted, the worker returned no coverage data, and this change touches no opcert code. Classified as a CI worker crash rather than a product finding and posted Gerrit `recheck`; retry run 31229199537 queued. LLM-Review remains +1 with zero unresolved comments.
